messages:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT: High 429 rate (hosted-api) observed starting ~17:40 UTC. Error rate across prod eu-west-1 spiked to ~15% for /v1/generate. Pager -> alyssa-oncall. Incident ID INC-2024-1745

alyssa-oncall: On it. Paging now. Quick triage shows sustained surge from a small set of heavy customers; our rate limiter is getting saturated. Proposing temporary mitigations: 1) reduce per-key burst quota, 2) disable streaming for affected tiers, 3) ask clients to back off. Support ops prepare customer comms.

mike-platform: Can we enforce token-level throttling per-route quickly? Also want to confirm Dedicated/committed customers excluded from emergency throttles?

alyssa-oncall: Token-level throttle by route applied (now). We excluded committed Dedicated accounts from this change. Pushing config change: route /v1/generate burst quota 100rps -> 30rps per API key. Rolling over 60s to avoid thundering.

incident-bot: CONFIG CHANGE: eng-deploy-bot applied rate-limiter update (deploy id: 5023). Rolled to shadow then prod. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/rate-limiter

sara-client-sdk: Drafting client guidance for SDKs — please review/ack. Short: reduce retry aggressiveness, use deferred retries with jitter, and ensure idempotency keys on requests that mutate state.

sara-client-sdk: ```http
# Recommended client behavior (pseudo)
InitialBackoff = 500ms
MaxRetries = 3
BackoffMultiplier = 2.0
Jitter = random(0..250ms)
# On 429 or 503 -> wait = InitialBackoff * (BackoffMultiplier ^ attempt) + Jitter
# Avoid immediate tight loops; prefer giving the server time to stabilize.
# Use an Idempotency-Key header for non-idempotent operations.
```

mike-platform: Also suggest a brief note for streaming clients: if you get 429 mid-stream treat it as a soft-failure — do not automatically re-send previously consumed tokens. Prefer resuming sessions when supported. Can we temporarily disable chunked streaming for non-enterprise keys?

alyssa-oncall: Yes — streaming disabled for non-enterprise/standard keys in eu-west-1 (toggle applied). Early estimate: ~18% reduction in peak load. Support-ops, please prepare the message to affected customers and include the SDK guidance snippet.

support-ops: Acknowledged. Drafting message:
"We're temporarily limiting burst capacity and disabling streaming for standard keys in eu-west-1 to stabilize latency. If you require higher sustained throughput, contact support to discuss Dedicated capacity. We will monitor and post updates every 5 minutes."

sara-client-sdk: Additional snippet for idempotency header example to include in SDK docs:

```http
POST /v1/generate
Idempotency-Key: <uuid-v4>
Content-Type: application/json
{ ... }
```

alyssa-oncall: Final guidance to client teams: cap retries at 3, start with 500ms initial backoff, exponential multiplier 2x, add randomized jitter up to 250ms. Require Idempotency-Key for operations that create resources or have side effects. I'll keep the thread open; next update in 10m or on rollback. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: error rate down to ~4% after mitigations. Keeping emergency limits in place while monitoring. Next scheduled check: 1745000600.
